name: STAPLE

prices.note: 42 regular-price hoodies of 71 in Sweatshirts & Hoodies (21 marked down, crewnecks excluded). Pigeon Logo Hoodie $98 at the bottom, Denim Pigeon Zip Hoodie $200 at the top. Sizes S–XL on all, 2XL on 38, 3XL on 34, XS on 30. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no markdown tag (markdown, clearance, outlet, final sale, sale-NN, NN% off, saleonsale, Apparel_Sale_). Hoodies only: pullover and zip-up hooded sweatshirts; crewnecks, hooded jackets, vests, knit hats/hoods, kids and sets excluded.

notes: Meta: 'STAPLE is a menswear collection distributed globally. Staple mixes street-minded sensibilities with mature sophisticated nods to high-end fashion.' og:title 'STAPLE - Streetwear Clothing Brand Founded by Jeff Staple'. Pigeon logo.
